items.title: Discourse's Release Completes: Reading the Room, Then Reading Oneself

items.zh: 觀察時眾者，謂立論者方起論端，應善觀察現前眾會，為有僻執，為無執耶？為有賢正，為無有耶？為有善巧，為無有耶？如是觀時，若知眾會唯有僻執，非無僻執；唯不賢正，無有賢正；唯不善巧，無善巧者。便自思勉，於是眾中不應立論。若知眾會無所僻執，非有僻執；唯有賢正，無不賢正；唯有善巧，無不善巧。便自思勉，於是眾中應當立論。
items.en: Examining the assembly at hand: it means that, at the outset of discourse, one should skilfully examine the assembly gathered — are they bound by biased views, or free of them? Are they worthy and upright, or not? Are they capable, or not? Examining in this way, if one finds the assembly bound entirely by biased views... one should exert oneself in reflection and not take up discourse before this assembly. If one finds the assembly free of biased views... one should exert oneself in reflection and take up discourse before this assembly.

items.zh: 是名第二或作不作論出離相。
觀察善巧不善巧者，謂立論者方起論端，應自觀察善與不善。我於論體、論處、論依、論嚴、論負、論出離等，為善巧耶？不善巧耶？我為有力能立自論、摧他論耶？於論負處能解脫耶？如是觀時，若自了知我無善巧，非有善巧；我無力能，非有力能；便自思勉，與對論者不應立論。若自了知我有善巧，非無善巧；我有勢力，非無勢力；便自思勉，與對論者當共立論。是名第三或作不作論出離相。
items.en: Examining one's own skill or lack of it: it means that, at the outset of discourse, one should examine oneself for skill or its absence — am I skilled or unskilled in the nature of discourse, its venue, its basis, its adornment, its defeat, and its release? Do I have the capacity to establish my own thesis and overturn another's? Can I free myself from the faults of defeat? Examining in this way, if one recognises a lack of skill... one should not take up discourse. If one recognises genuine skill... one should take up discourse together with the opponent. This is called the third mark of discourse's release, concerning whether or not to act.

items.title: The Science of Logic Concludes: The Methods of Greatest Use, and All Seven Headings Complete

items.zh: 論多所作法者，謂有三種於所立論多所作法。一、善自他宗，二、勇猛無畏，三、辯才無竭。
items.en: The methods of greatest use in discourse: there are three qualities of great use to any discourse advanced. First, mastery of one's own and other positions; second, courageous fearlessness; and third, inexhaustible eloquence.

items.zh: 問：如是三法，於所立論，何故名為多有所作？答：能善了知自他宗故，於一切法能起談論；勇猛無畏故，處一切眾能起談論；辯才無竭故，隨所問難皆善酬答。是故此三，於所立論多有所作。
items.en: Question: why are these three qualities called of such great use to discourse? Answer: because mastering one's own and other positions well, one can engage in discourse on any matter; because of courageous fearlessness, one can engage in discourse before any assembly; and because of inexhaustible eloquence, one can skilfully answer whatever difficulty is raised. This is why these three are of such great use to discourse.

items.title: The Fourth Science Opens: Linguistics, and Its Sixfold Framework

items.zh: 已說因明處。云何聲明處？當知此處略有六相。一、法施設建立相，二、義施設建立相，三、補特伽羅施設建立相，四、時施設建立相，五、數施設建立相，六、處所根栽施設建立相。
items.en: The science of logic has now been explained. What is the science of linguistics? Know that, briefly, it has six aspects: first, the establishment of words; second, the establishment of meaning; third, the establishment of grammatical person; fourth, the establishment of tense; fifth, the establishment of number; and sixth, the establishment of the domains [of usage] and their roots.

items.zh: 嗢拕南曰：法、義、數取趣、時、數、與處所，若根栽所依，是略聲明相。
云何法施設建立？謂名身、句身、文身、及五德相應聲。一、不鄙陋，二、輕易，三、雄朗，四、相應，五、義善。
items.en: What is the establishment of words? It refers to the body of names, the body of sentences, the body of letters, and speech endowed with five virtues: first, free of rustic, provincial diction; second, readily understood; third, vigorous and clear; fourth, coherent; and fifth, wholesome in meaning.

items.title: The Establishment of Meaning: Ten Domains Language Exists to Describe

items.zh: 云何義施設建立？當知略有十種。一、根建立，二、大種建立，三、業建立，四、尋求建立，五、非法建立，六、法建立，七、興盛建立，八、衰損建立，九、受用建立，十、守護建立。
items.en: What is the establishment of meaning? Know that, briefly, it has ten kinds: first, the establishment of the faculties; second, the establishment of the great elements; third, the establishment of action; fourth, the establishment of seeking; fifth, the establishment of the unwholesome; sixth, the establishment of the wholesome; seventh, the establishment of flourishing; eighth, the establishment of decline; ninth, the establishment of enjoyment; and tenth, the establishment of protection.

items.zh: 嗢拕南曰：眼等、與地等、身等、及尋求、非法、法、興盛、衰損、受用、護。
根建立者，謂見義、聞義、嗅義、甞義、觸義、知義。大種建立者，謂依持等義、澆潤等義、照了等義、動搖等義。業建立者，謂往來等義、宣說等義、思念覺察等義。尋求建立者，謂追訪等義。
items.en: The establishment of the faculties: the meanings of seeing, hearing, smelling, tasting, touching, and cognizing. The establishment of the great elements: the meaning of supporting, of moistening, of illuminating, and of stirring. The establishment of action: the meanings of coming and going, of proclaiming, and of thinking and discerning. The establishment of seeking: the meaning of pursuing and inquiring.

items.zh: 非法建立者，謂殺盜等義。法建立者，謂施戒等義。興盛建立者，謂證得、喜悅等義。衰損建立者，謂破壞、怖畏、憂慼等義。受用建立者，謂飲食、覆障、抱持、受行等義。守護建立者，謂守護、育養、盛滿等義。
items.en: The establishment of the unwholesome: the meanings of killing, stealing, and the like. The establishment of the wholesome: the meanings of giving, upholding precepts, and the like. The establishment of flourishing: the meanings of attainment and joy. The establishment of decline: the meanings of ruin, fear, and grief. The establishment of enjoyment: the meanings of food, shelter, embrace, and use. The establishment of protection: the meanings of guarding, nurturing, and reaching fullness.

items.zh: 又復略說有六種義。一、自性義，二、因義，三、果義，四、作用義，五、差別相應義，六、轉義。
items.en: Briefly stated again, there are six kinds of meaning: first, the meaning of self-nature; second, the meaning of cause; third, the meaning of result; fourth, the meaning of function; fifth, the meaning of associated distinctions; and sixth, the meaning of arising.

items.zh: 嗢拕南曰：自性、與因、果、作用、相應、轉。

items.title: Grammatical Person, Tense, and Number: How Language Marks the Speaker and the Moment

items.zh: 云何補特伽羅施設建立？謂建立男、女、非男非女聲相差別；或復建立初中上士聲相差別。
items.en: What is the establishment of grammatical person? It refers to establishing the distinct forms of masculine, feminine, and neither-masculine-nor-feminine gender; and also establishing the distinct forms proper to the lowest, middle, and highest person.

items.zh: 云何時施設建立？謂有三時聲相差別。一、過去過去殊勝，二、未來未來殊勝，三、現在現在殊勝。云何數施設建立？謂有三數聲相差別。一者、一數，二者、二數，三者、多數。
items.en: What is the establishment of tense? It refers to the distinct forms of three times: first, the past and the especially past; second, the future and the especially future; and third, the present and the especially present. What is the establishment of number? It refers to the distinct forms of three numbers: first, the singular; second, the dual; and third, the plural.

items.title: Linguistics Concludes: The Domains of Usage, the Root Treatises, and How Words Are Actually Formed

items.zh: 云何處所根栽施設建立？當知處所略有五種。一、相續，二、名號，三、總略，四、彼益，五、宣說。若界頌等，名為根栽。如是二種，總名處所根栽建立。
items.en: What is the establishment of the domains and their roots? Know that the domains [in which sounds, names, sentences, and letters are used], briefly, are of five kinds: first, combination; second, naming; third, condensed statement; fourth, secondary suffixation; and fifth, verbal exposition. Works such as the Dhātu Verses (界頌), a treatise on the verbal roots, are called the roots. These two together are called the establishment of the domains and their roots.

items.title: The Fifth Science and Fascicle Complete: Twelve Practical Arts, and the Ground of Hearing Closes

items.zh: 已說聲明處。云何工業明處？謂於十二處略說工業所有妙智名工業明處。何等十二工業處耶？謂營農工業、商估工業、事王工業、書算計度數印工業、占相工業、呪術工業、營造工業、生成工業、防那工業、和合工業、成熟工業、音樂工業。
items.en: The science of linguistics has now been explained. What is the science of the practical arts? Briefly stated across twelve domains, the subtle skill belonging to the practical arts is called the science of the practical arts. What are the twelve domains of practical work? Farming; commerce; service to the state; writing, arithmetic, calculation, and seal-craft; divination; the arts of incantation; construction; animal husbandry; weaving and textile work; conciliation and mediation; food preparation; and music.

blocks.text: The last reading of fascicle 15 completes logic and then, briefly, the two remaining sciences, **linguistics** and the **practical arts**. With it, the tenth stage, the Stage Attained Through Hearing, is complete.

Before debating, examine the assembly and oneself. Master Cháng Bǎi: consider "whether their minds are partisan; whether their conduct is upright; whether their wisdom is capable." Then examine oneself: am I skilled in the subject? Venerable Miào Jìng reads one question as: can I keep free of the faults of defeat?

Three methods are most useful: mastery of both positions, perfect speech, and fearlessness. Master Cháng Bǎi: restraint and worthiness are left out because they concern personal manner rather than wisdom and eloquence. In all, he counts thirty-six items plus seven headings, forty-three rules of right and wrong argument.

The science of **linguistics** (聲明, *śabdavidyā*), Venerable Miào Jìng says, is really "the Indians' learning in literature, the study of writing". It has six aspects, all "establishments". Venerable Miào Jìng compares them to building a house: foundation, walls, beams, windows, and doors, each in order.

Names, phrases, and letters (Day 36) are spoken as sound and, when written, become visible form. The establishment of meaning covers ten domains of sentient life and six of phenomena, as Master Cháng Bǎi explains. The establishment of the wholesome, "giving, precepts, and the like", is, Venerable Miào Jìng says, "the way to live with all beings". Grammatical person, tense, and number follow: how language marks the speaker and the moment.
The **practical arts** (工業明) are named in twelve kinds: farming, trade, service, writing and calculation, crafts, and others. A bodhisattva learns them to benefit beings.

"The Stage Attained Through Hearing has been explained." Hearing, for this treatise, is not passive. It is learning everything that can serve beings and the path: the Buddha's teaching above all, and also medicine, logic, language, and practical skill.

Fascicle 15 has completed the teachings by number and then covered the four "outer" sciences. Logic took most of the space, because a teacher in India had to defend the Dharma in public. Its lessons, though, apply to any honest conversation. Fascicle 16 begins the eleventh stage, the **Stage Attained Through Reflection** (思所成地).

quiz.q: What three things does Master Cháng Bǎi say to examine in the assembly?
options: whether their minds are biased, their conduct upright, their wisdom capable
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: "Consider whether their minds are partisan; whether their conduct is worthy and upright; whether their wisdom is skilful." Those with fixed biased views won't be persuaded.

quiz.q: The three most useful methods come from the five adornments. Why are restraint and worthiness left out, per Master Cháng Bǎi?
options: restraint and worthiness concern personal morality and manner; the three chosen concern wisdom and eloquence
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: restraint and worthiness mostly concern personal morality, so they aren't included; the first three concern wisdom and eloquence. Inexhaustible eloquence belongs to perfected speech; courage is fearlessness.

quiz.q: How many items in all does Master Cháng Bǎi count in the science of logic?
options: thirty-six, plus the seven general headings, making forty-three — all rules of right and wrong argument are here
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: adding to these thirty-six items the seven general headings — nature, venue, and the rest — makes forty-three; all the rules of right and wrong argument are contained here.

quiz.q: What, per Venerable Miào Jìng, is the science of 聲明 really?
options: the Indian learning of literature and writing
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: "The science of 聲明 is really the Indians' learning in literature — the study of writing." Master Cháng Bǎi, citing an encyclopedia, describes roots, affixes, and inflections.

quiz.q: All six aspects are "establishments" (施設建立). What image does Venerable Miào Jìng use for 施設?
options: building a house — laying the foundation, walls, beams, windows, and doors in order
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: like a house — prepare the foundation, walls, beams, windows, and doors, arrange them, and it is built. 施設 is arranging; 建立 is what stands once arranged.

quiz.q: The establishment of meaning has a set of ten and a set of six. How does Master Cháng Bǎi, citing the Pixunji, distinguish them?
options: the ten concern the life of sentient beings; the six concern the arising of phenomena
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: "The ten discussed here concern the differences in sentient life; the six concern differences in how phenomena arise." The six are illustrated with eye-consciousness and its conditions.

quiz.q: The establishment of the wholesome is "giving, precepts, and the like." What does Venerable Miào Jìng draw from this?
options: the way of living with all beings — give, keep precepts, be patient, diligent, meditative, and wise, and it is complete
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: "It tells us the way to live with all beings: giving, precepts, patience, diligence, meditation, wisdom — then it is complete." Master Cháng Bǎi's lecture lists the six once and the ten wholesome deeds elsewhere.
